# SproutMe

SproutMe lists electronic music (EDM) shows across North America.

## For agents (Instinct, Muse, Claude, ChatGPT)

Do not scrape this website. Use the public JSON API:

- OpenAPI: https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/openapi.json
- Search: https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/v1/events?city=Seattle&genre=house&limit=10
- One event: https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/v1/events/{id}
- Add event: POST https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/v1/events
- MCP: POST https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/mcp
- Agent instructions: https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/llms.txt

MCP tools: search_events, get_event, add_event.

Muse Code:

```json
{
  "mcp_servers": {
    "sproutme": {
      "transport": "streamable_http",
      "url": "https://phelpsm4.pythonanywhere.com/mcp",
      "enabled": true,
      "mode": "optional"
    }
  }
}
```
